_meanings:
.²1 Close adherence or attendance; connection, conjunction, association;
 {#tasya vErAnuzaNgasya gantA'smyantaM sudurgamam#} <ls>Mb. 5. 162. 35</ls>. {#sAnuzaNgARi#}
 {#kalyARAni#} <ls>U. 7</ls> good things closely follow one another (come close upon one another).
.²2 Coalition, commixture.
.²3 Connection of word with word.
.²4 A word or words repeated from the context to supply an ellipsis. <ab>cf.</ab>
 {#anuzaNgaSca PalavacanamaBavizyat#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 5</ls>.
.²5 Necessary consequence, inevitable result.
.²6 Connection of a subsequent with a previous act.
.²7 Incidental mention or relation ({#prasaNga#}).
.²8 Yearning, eager longing.
.²9 Compassion, pity, tenderness.
.²10 (In Nyāya) Connecting together the {#upanaya#} or application and
 {#nigamana#} or conclusion by the use of the pronoun {#idaM#} ({#upanayavAkyasTasya#}
 {#ayamiti padasya nigamanavAkye AkarzaRam#}).
.²11 The nasals connected with certain roots ending in consonants; <ls>P. VII. 1. 59. Sk.</ls>
.²12 An ellipsis. A mode of interpreting an incomplete sentence by supplying
 the required word or words from the immediate context. This mode is admissible
 only if there is no break ({#vyavAya#}). This corresponds to the principle
 known as {#anuvftti#} (in grammar) on which a word or expression from
 a preceding {#sUtra#} is read in the succeeding {#sUtra#} or {#sUtra#}s.
 {#nAnuzaNgaH prApnuyAt . kutaH . vyavAyAt .#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 4. 7</ls>.
